title: Explain format!("{cap}") string dispatch in handle_enable
description: In session/mod.rs, the ENABLE handler converts each CapabilityEnable to a string with format!("{cap}") and passes it to handle_enable() for case-insensitive string comparison. There is no comment explaining why a direct enum-variant match is not used instead. The reason is that the imap-types CapabilityEnable type has no dedicated Imap4Rev2 variant at the version pinned in Cargo.toml, making Display-based dispatch the only viable approach. Without this explanation, a new contributor will likely attempt to replace the string comparison with a pattern match and be confused when no such variant exists.
